prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: knee injury. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1285; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter is written on behalf of our client, [CLIENT_NAME], regarding injuries sustained in a collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was traveling at a low rate of speed when the other vehicle crossed into the client's lane and struck it head-on. The impact was significant enough to force the client's knee against the interior of the vehicle, resulting in a painful injury that has required ongoing medical evaluation and treatment.

Our client has since been advised by treating providers that the knee injury will require a course of physical therapy, and that future care may be necessary depending on the response to treatment. Our client has also missed time from work while recovering, and has experienced persistent pain and limited mobility that affect daily activities.

Liability in this matter appears clear. The other driver's failure to remain in their lane directly caused the collision, and no fault can fairly be assigned to our client. We have enclosed the available medical records, billing statements, and the police report for your review.

On behalf of our client, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will proceed with filing a lawsuit without further notice.
